freegames.label: Free games
freegames.description: Announces games that become free to keep (Steam, Epic Games, GOG) in a channel.
freegames.embedDescription:
🎮 **Free to keep** on {store} for a limited time!
[View on the store]({url})

command.description: Show the games that are currently free (Steam, Epic, GOG).
command.title: 🎮 **{count}** free-to-keep game(s):

channelId.label: Announcement channel
channelId.help: The channel where free games are announced. Empty, the module posts nothing: that is how you put it to sleep without losing the rest of the settings.

roleId.label: Role to mention
roleId.help: Pinged on each announcement. Best made a self-assignable role: offers land at any hour, and pinging the whole server over a free game wears thin fast.

platforms.label: Platforms followed
platforms.help: The stores being watched. Unticking them all amounts to turning the module off. Epic gives a game away weekly, Steam and GOG only now and then: keeping just those two makes announcements rare but never routine.

announceNow.label: Announce the current offers
announceNow.help: Reposts the games currently free on the ticked platforms, and marks them as announced.

msg.badChannel: Channel not found or not a text channel.
msg.noOffer: No free offer at the moment.
